{{RV|type=command

|game1= arma3
|version1= 2.10

|gr1= GUI Control

|descr= Sets 'shadow' property of the control:
* 0 - no shadow
* 1 - shadow
* 2 - outline

|s1= control [[ctrlSetShadow]] shadow

|p1= control: [[Control]]
|p2= shadow: [[Number]] - shadow value, see description

|r1= [[Nothing]]

|x1= <sqf>_control ctrlSetShadow 1;</sqf>
